title: Huntermark
description: This project adds custom swords and the ability to put bounties on people! (ALPHA version)
body:
# HunterMark

> **A complete bounty hunting experience for Paper 1.21.11+ featuring player-driven bounties, hunter tools, streak rewards, and four legendary swords with unique abilities.**

Turn PvP into a true hunt. Place bounties on players, track targets, claim rewards, and rise through the hunter rankings to earn the coveted **Top Hunter Aura**.

**Paper 1.21.11 • Java 21 Required**

---

## Features

### Bounty System

* Create bounties using a GUI escrow system
* Automatic expiry and refunds
* Early cancellation with configurable fee
* Hunter streak bonuses up to +50% rewards
* Anti-abuse protections including cooldowns, minimum values, and world restrictions

### Hunter Tools

* **Hunter's Compass** tracks your claimed target
* **Wanted Poster** broadcasts a target's approximate location
* **Hunter's Trophy** drops a collectible player head on bounty claims
* Wanted players emit particles
* Top bounty hunter receives a glowing aura and gold particles

### Legendary Swords

| Sword                | Playstyle                                                   |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Hunter's Verdict** | Aggressive hunter blade with Sonic Boom and target marking  |
| **Moonwake**         | Lunar sword with stronger abilities at night                |
| **Bloodwake**        | Evolved Moonwake focused on bleed and area damage           |
| **Riftpiercer**      | Mobility-focused void blade with dashes, swaps, and prisons |

Use `/bounty swords` in-game for complete ability information.

### Quality of Life

* Cooldown management system
* Full command tab-completion
* Player-friendly help menus
* Configurable balancing options
* SQLite data storage with persistent stats

---

## Installation

1. Place `HunterMark.jar` into your `plugins` folder
2. Start the server
3. Configure `config.yml` if desired
4. Run `/bounty reload`

**Requires Paper 1.21.11+ and Java 21**

---

## Player Commands

| Command                   | Description            |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `/bounty <player>`        | Create a bounty        |
| `/bounty claim <player>`  | Track a target         |
| `/bounty cancel <player>` | Cancel your bounty     |
| `/bounty compass`         | Get a tracking compass |
| `/bounty streak`          | View streak progress   |
| `/bounty swords`          | View sword abilities   |
| `/bounty cooldowns`       | View ability cooldowns |
| `/bounties`               | View active bounties   |

---

## Admin Commands

| Command                   | Description               |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| `/bounty reload`          | Reload configs            |
| `/bounty stats`           | View plugin statistics    |
| `/bounty multiplier`      | Adjust reward multipliers |
| `/bounty items`           | Spawn custom items        |
| `/bounty cooldown`        | Modify ability cooldowns  |
| `/bounty cooldowns reset` | Restore default cooldowns |
| `/bounty setkills`        | Modify sword progression  |
| `/bounty fx`              | Test sword effects        |

---

## Permissions

| Permission           | Description           |
| -------------------- | --------------------- |
| `huntermark.use`     | Use bounty system     |
| `huntermark.claim`   | Claim bounties        |
| `huntermark.cancel`  | Cancel bounties       |
| `huntermark.compass` | Use hunter compass    |
| `huntermark.reload`  | Reload plugin         |
| `huntermark.admin`   | Administrative access |

---

## Storage

* **SQLite** (default)
* Persistent bounty, player, and hunter data
* MySQL support planned for a future release

---

## Sword Abilities

### Hunter's Verdict

* **Sonic Boom** — Piercing ranged attack
* **Marked For Judgment** — Mark targets for bonus damage
* **Passive:** Increases escape difficulty for marked targets

### Moonwake

* **Moon Shard** — Crescent projectile attack
* **Moon Veil** — Protective moonlight shield
* **Passive:** Stronger during nighttime

### Bloodwake

* Obtained by evolving Moonwake after 3 player kills
* **Crimson Orbit** — Orbiting damaging moons
* **Blood Moon Pulse** — Defensive shockwave
* **Passive:** Gains bonuses during Blood Moon events

### Riftpiercer

* **Rift Dash** — High-speed void movement
* **Dimensional Swap** — Swap positions with enemies
* **Rift Prison** — Trap targets in a void arena
* **Passive:** Charge system that empowers abilities

---

## Recipes

Crafting recipes are available in the **Gallery** tab.

---

## Beta Notes

* All bounty and sword systems are fully functional
* SQLite is currently recommended
* WorldGuard integration is planned
* Balance values can be adjusted through configuration

Report bugs and feedback through Modrinth comments!
